repository.name: agid-postal-jo
repository.purpose: Jordan postal-context contract seed for an independent country-data repository linked to AGID

postal_system.legal_rule: Jordan Post is the designated postal operator. The dated UPU Jordan addressing sheet describes five digits and a region-department-zone-sector-unit coding structure. The policy PDF titled ICT and Postal Policy 2025 calls for completion of physical street and building addressing in sections 104 and 131. Its title, 2019 HTTP modification time and planning targets do not verify actual 2026 implementation. The earlier carrier-route sorting claim is not supported by the reviewed PDF. These references are not current bulk assignments, canonical postal polygons, exact civic addresses, building relations or redistribution rights.
postal_system.assignment_rule: Store a postcode as a five-character digit string preserving leading zeroes. Production assignment requires an exact current Jordan Post or rights-cleared provider record with code, object type, authority, validity, retrieval timestamp, response schema and digest pinned. UPU examples, post-office rows, village codes, administrative codes, coordinates, street names, map labels, policy statements and proximity do not create an assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No reviewed canonical national Jordan postcode polygon artifact is bundled. A postal-authority surface requires an exact geometry artifact and postcode relation with authority, edition, coverage, rights, CRS, topology and digest pinned. Joining a proven routing assignment to a permitted administrative boundary remains a derived routing-administrative join surface with uncertainty. Post offices and P.O. boxes remain point or non-area objects. Administrative boundaries, street extents, village codes, Voronoi, interpolation, OSM and models never become official postal polygons.
postal_system.address_rule: Recipient, organization, apartment or unit, building or premise number, street, neighbourhood, locality, district, governorate, P.O. Box and postal code remain typed and validity-aware. Postal policy records incomplete national physical addressing. A postcode, carrier route, post office, coordinate, village code, street record, digital mailbox pilot or map feature alone does not identify a recipient, owner, occupant, entrance, unit, exact legal civic address or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires an explicit rights-cleared civic-address identifier, a stable reviewed relation to a building identifier, and separately permitted building geometry with purpose, validity, privacy, CRS and digests pinned. The RJGC-Greater Amman MoU documents controlled institutional exchange, not a public building dataset. Postcode containment, post-office proximity, village or street match, coordinate equality, parcel overlap and nearest-building logic are candidates or validation evidence only.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. A postal object or derived surface may link to AGID cells through an explicit versioned crosswalk without relabelling a postcode, administrative identifier, village code, digital mailbox or building as an AGID cell, or claiming AGID geometry is postal-authority geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: The Jordan Open Government Data License applies only to an exact artifact expressly published under it. Pin publisher, item URL, publication and download dates, license version, attribution, schema, digest and any amendments. Jordan Post, UPU, MODEE, TRC, RJGC, DLS, GAM, Petra, portals, viewers, services, policies, institutional MoUs and public access do not by themselves grant blanket row, layer, address, cadastral or building redistribution rights.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Recipients, senders, P.O. Box holders, postcode and address queries, digital mailbox or Sanad links, home locations, phones, emails, identities, households, residents, owners, occupants, tenants, parcels, cadastral records, access credentials and private premises are excluded from public artifacts. Only explicitly public or licensed non-personal fields may enter a production pack.

stages.definition: Metadata-only source contract and synthetic runtime; no production assignment, address or geometry release.

A current rights-cleared Jordan Post routing-assignment release complete for its declared source, jurisdiction and time scope preserves five-digit strings and typed locality, post-office, route and P.O. Box objects, with reproducible full-data conversion and validation, immutable published data and actual AGID loader/API verification. Postal offices, dated UPU syntax, incomplete physical-addressing policy, villages, streets, MoUs and digital-mailbox pilots cannot substitute for assignments, official postal polygons or explicit civic-address/building relations. Geometry, derived surfaces, civic/building links, privacy, validity and reuse rights remain independently evidenced.
